Forest Gnome.description: Possessing a natural knack for illusion and inherent swiftness, closely bonded with woodland creatures.

features.name: Natural Illusionist
features.tldr: You know the *Minor Illusion* cantrip. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for it.

Rock Gnome.description: Naturally inventive and hardy, with a sharp mind for crafting clockwork devices and gadgets.

features.name: Artisan's Tinker
features.tldr: You have proficiency with artisan's tools (tinker's tools) and can construct small clockwork devices.
